players.product: High-k ALD precursor materials for advanced DRAM; photoacid generators and metallic compounds for EUV / advanced photoresists

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor Materials, H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025; lower sales and profit): high-k material sales for advanced DRAM were weak on the price revision made in the previous year and on market production adjustments accompanying the design-rule generation change; the company began shipping a new product for memory scaling from the second quarter. Sales of lithography materials for advanced photoresists were strong on data-center investment and demand for generative-AI devices.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor Materials H1 net sales 157 (100 million yen), down 10.3%; operating profit 33 (100 million yen), down 28.6%
